source: Independently read Table125 at physical368–369, its Type1 NOTE2, CFF length restriction and PaintType prose. Actual Table348 metadata is physical730/printed715, not715/700; NOTE1 says font dictionary, not descriptor. Read #296 UTF-8 insertion. Table348 is contextual here and not counted as a new complete cell matrix.
navigation: The two Gotoerrata widgets at physical369 navigate to physical1021 Issue475 (public-key security reserved bits) and physical1022 Issue462 (ToUnicode Table125a). These unrelated targets are not evidence of a Type1/Length3 amendment. Issue annotations on368–369 do not amend these cells.
assertions: Read actual program.rs zero-Length3 test: untouched prefix, 512 ASCII zeros, terminal cleartomark. Its helper payload is not a full font. The positive Length3=533 helper has no trailer and is malformed recovery evidence. Read public font_paint_type_audit generated valid Type1, Length1/2 and zero Length3, nonempty outline/half-em advance/Tr controls. It reaches append but does not discriminate omission; the direct byte oracle does.
decisions: Read selected ADR0459 decoded extents and damaged-filter distinction, ADR0475 obsolete unexecuted Length3 statement, ADR0040 historical lengths-unread statement, ADR1221 Table124 writing-direction/Subtype rule. Keep extent-based bounded recovery and byte-signature reader tolerance; no new mandatory invalid-input rejection. Historical prose remains unchanged.
limits: Partial selected review; no all-font certification or font-specific metadata UI claim. No additional test was needed for the byte append obligation.
